attempts.exact_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a single static master proposal for the Heroes of Might and Magic III Necropolis Skeleton Warrior, for a 2D game sprite collection. Produce ONE full-body character, no sheet, no animation.
Input images: Image 1 (native-idle-6x.png) is the authoritative identity, silhouette, facing, proportions and idle pose. Image 2 (native-g07-guide.png) is supplementary ORIGINAL equipment/anatomy evidence from turning poses, not a requested output pose. Image 3 (native-g01-guide.png) is supplementary ORIGINAL shield/sword material evidence, not a requested output pose. Image 4 (pikeman-rendering-master.png) is RENDERING STYLE ONLY: fine modeled volume, textured surfaces, restrained colors and concentrated highlights. Do not borrow Pikeman's helmet, body, outfit, heraldry, blue/yellow palette or weapon.
Primary request: faithfully redraw the original upgraded Skeleton Warrior as finely modeled, textured game artwork, keeping the exact native idle stance in Image 1 and its right-facing three-quarter side view. The original reference takes priority over generic skeleton fantasy design. This must be newly rendered artwork, not enlarged original pixels.
Identity and materials: a very slender, human-proportioned undead skeleton with aged pale ivory/gray-green bones, empty dark eye sockets and exposed skeletal upper arms, forearms, hands, thighs, shins and feet inside the native boots. Dark charcoal helmet with ONE small pointed top spike and modest cheek/neck guards as shown. Slim muted violet-gray metal torso cuirass with subtle plate/rib shaping and a small dark hip covering; keep the arms and long legs uncovered bone. Dark brown-black armored ankle/calf boots with flared tops and a few concentrated worn steel glints. One straight narrow steel sword with a modest crossguard and dark grip. One small round dark violet/black metal shield with a worn bronze/gold rim, sparse rim studs and central boss; its native idle perspective makes it a narrow vertical oval on the screen-right side of the body. No extravagant decoration.
Pose: match Image 1 closely. Skull looks to screen-right, neck and upper torso lean slightly forward, pelvis sits back, narrow legs in the same separated bent ready stance with both boot soles at the same ground level. The sword arm is on screen-left, elbow bent behind the torso, hand held low beside the rear hip; blade runs diagonally downward to screen-right across the legs and ends near the forward boot's ankle. Shield arm is on screen-right, bent in front of the torso, holding the small shield close to ribs/hip with the same oblique angle. Do not turn the chest or shield face toward the viewer more than the native idle. Preserve the source's lean sparse silhouette, long thin bones, ordinary skull size and original prop length.
Style/medium: match the Pikeman reference's polished but restrained textured modeled-volume illustration, with fine rounded shading, clearly differentiated porous old bone, dull violet steel, worn bronze rim and dark boot leather/metal. Small purposeful concentrated steel highlights; subdued broad tones. Clean sprite silhouette, crisp fine detail, no chunky pixel clusters and no heavy cartoon outline.
Composition/framing: one isolated full body at large useful resolution, approximately 600 pixels tall in a 1024x1024 transparent image, centered with generous empty margins on all sides. Keep the entire helmet spike, both feet, sword tip, guard and shield inside frame. Preserve the narrow width-to-height ratio of the native idle (approximately 42:86) without stretching the anatomy. This high-resolution raw will later be uniformly registered to a 1024x768 transparent cell at about 212 pixels visible height using the common 180/73 source scale; do not add registration guides.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha outside the character AND through all open gaps between its bones and limbs. No ground, floor, cast shadow, contact shadow, halo, glow, atmospheric effects or background.
Constraints: original Necropolis identity and upgraded equipment first. No Castle costume or colors, no new weapons, no cape, no horns, no glowing eyes, no magic, no inflated armor, no full suit of armor, no chibi proportions, no labels, text, border, watermark or comparison panel. Only this single right-facing native-idle Skeleton Warrior.

Bone remains matte old ivory/gray-green, armor dull violet-gray, rim worn bronze, blade steel. Preserve the fine textured modeled shading of the target; no coarse pixel blocks, heavy outlines or cartoon/chibi forms.
